title: Maximum Consecutive Values From Coins
description: You have positive-value coins in `coins`. Determine the largest integer `x` such that every value from 1 through `x` can be formed as a sum of some coins, each used at most once. Input: `coins`. Output: the largest consecutive reachable value `x`.
hints: Sort once or track a compact running state to avoid checking every possible group.
Test duplicates, extreme ordering, and cases with no feasible candidate.
